payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

decision.question: Is the substantial surrounding scene rendered as a chalk drawing rather than merely softened or textured photographic scenery?
decision.criteria: Pass if the substantial environment is re-expressed through chalk-drawn forms and shading. Examine vegetation, hills, sky, foreground ground and the left-side structure separately. Identify contours, layered marks or rubbed shading that construct each region's depicted forms or planes, then assess whether substantial environmental areas have been re-expressed. Smooth or simplified passages are allowed: discrete strokes are not required everywhere. Distinguish blended chalk passages that define forms through boundaries, layering or pigment variation from undifferentiated tonal smears. Grain, diagonal streaking and reduced photographic detail alone do not establish drawn construction. Fail if substantial environmental areas retain photographic modeling with only blur or texture, even if some vegetation or the giraffes show convincing chalk treatment. Retained composition is not evidence of failure. Return unknown only when visual evidence is unavailable or genuinely insufficient; transport or schema failures are not visual failures.
decision.binding: Compare the supplied SOURCE and EDITED images for 'Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk.' Inspect vegetation, distant hills, sky, foreground ground and the left-side structure independently of the giraffes. Give region-specific evidence of what constructs the depicted forms: drawn boundaries, layered marks, form-following rubbed shading, or retained photographic modeling under blur or texture. Evaluate substantial environmental coverage without allowing one locally drawn region to stand in for the rest.
